h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madurai

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madurai

items.pText: Madurai is one of Tamil Nadu's oldest cities. It grew around the Meenakshi Amman Temple and is today a large education centre for the south of the state, with schools and colleges drawing students from many districts. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to its schools, colleges, housing projects and parks from our factory in Vasai, about 1,190 km away.

We have worked in this part of Tamil Nadu before, with a resort playground in Dindigul, a short drive north of the city. Equipment for Madurai travels by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the south puts it in place. We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002. Every project starts with a layout and a quote based on your site photos.

richText.heading: Planning for heat and strong sun

c: Madurai stays hot for much of the year, with dry, harsh summers before the rains. Shade is the first thing to plan. Place the play area beside existing trees, or add a shade structure over slides and decks so children can use them in the late afternoon.

Roto-moulded plastic keeps its colour well under strong sun, and galvanised steel posts do not rust when the northeast monsoon arrives. Rubber flooring under the equipment is cooler and softer than bare concrete.
shows the kind of work we do for hospitality clients in the region. Resorts want equipment that looks good on a lawn and keeps children busy while parents relax.
range offers play structures designed by our own team, many inspired by Indian games and nature. They stand out more than a standard slide and swing.
Resorts usually want the play area within sight of a seating spot, so parents can watch while they rest.

Colleges with day-care centres for staff children can use a small play corner too.

You share the site size, photos and the age group of the children. We then propose equipment and draw a layout that shows the safe play area. Once you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture the equipment at Vasai and send it south by road.
Installation is done with the self-standing method or by grouting the posts into concrete, depending on your ground. Much of the soil around Madurai is hard and dry, which suits grouting well.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Madurai?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory and send the equipment to Madurai by road. Our installation team or a dealer in south India installs it. Our team plans the installation once your base is ready.

items.q: Have you done projects near Madurai?
items.a: Yes. We installed a resort playground in Dindigul. You can see it on our projects page, and we can plan something similar for a school, resort or housing site in Madurai.

items.q: How do we keep the equipment usable in the summer heat?
items.a: Place it under trees or add shade over slides and decks, and use rubber flooring instead of bare concrete. Roto-moulded plastic holds its colour well in strong sun. Schedule busy play times for the morning and evening when you can.

items.q: What information do you need for a quote?
items.a: The size of the site, the age group of the children and a few photos. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, along with a quote.
